title: Intimacy and consent
learning_outcomes: Explain voluntary ongoing consent in the context of intimacy and consent.
Compare and distinguish pressure and ambiguity in the context of intimacy and consent.
Apply preference discussion in the context of intimacy and consent.
Evaluate and justify decisions about safeguarding resources in the context of intimacy and consent.

lessons.title: Voluntary ongoing consent
lessons.outcome: Explain voluntary ongoing consent in the context of intimacy and consent.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving voluntary ongoing consent; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to consent scenario assessment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain voluntary ongoing consent from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of voluntary ongoing consent; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Pressure and ambiguity
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish pressure and ambiguity in the context of intimacy and consent.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving pressure and ambiguity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to consent scenario assessment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain pressure and ambiguity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of pressure and ambiguity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Preference discussion
lessons.outcome: Apply preference discussion in the context of intimacy and consent.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving preference discussion; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to consent scenario assessment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain preference discussion from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of preference discussion; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Safeguarding resources
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about safeguarding resources in the context of intimacy and consent.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving safeguarding resources; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to consent scenario assessment.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain safeguarding resources from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of safeguarding resources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of voluntary ongoing consent; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of pressure and ambiguity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of preference discussion; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of safeguarding resources; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
